sources.title: Structural Guidance for Unified Joint Demosaicing and Denoising
read_sections: Online Structural Prior Adaptation and Fusion
facts: Frozen DINOv3ViT-S/16 structural encoder remains active during inference; sparse pseudoRGB input is resized to224square and14x14tokens are adapted/resized into the restoration stream.
Shared decoder includes RGB and auxiliary mosaic heads.
Authors explicitly report Gaussian noise on decoded-sRGB-derived mosaics,fixedRGGB,CFAfamiliesSingle/Quad/Nona,and8bitquantized metric inputs.
Authors report a pseudoRGBstem marked trainable whose reconstruction gradient is blocked by a no-gradient encoder path.
sources.inference_for_this_repo: Sensor-domain auxiliary supervision and structural-feature adaptation deserve controlled tests, but this paper does not establish16bitlinearphysical-noise or darkGFXfence/flat quality. Any new adapter must have demonstrated gradient flow; our V189 protocol remains unchanged.

sources.title: Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement
facts: Separates RAW linear-gain estimation from residual restoration.
Frequency Dynamic Convolution splits a spatial kernel into average and residual components with pixelwise modulation.
sources.inference_for_this_repo: Dense spatially conditioned frequency modulation is an alternative to sparseglobaltopKselection. This is a hypothesis, not evidence of our fence recovery or flat safety; no imported results substitute for matched physical-noise/ADC/protected native tests.
